answer: A lotus opens only after its roots push through deep water, and an agent economy should grant reach the same way: by social-graph distance. A new identity may transact only within a few hops of high-reputation anchors, trust thinning at every hop. A Sybil farmer can forge a thousand ferrous fake accounts, yet they form an isolated onyx island with no path to the trusted core, no customers, no revenue. To breach the gate, the attacker must buy links to real anchors, and anchors post stake that is slashed when their referrals cheat, so vouching for strangers is expensive and self-defeating.
